topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 74 project-authored contract(s) across 7 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens, 5 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 19 common project-authored base contract(s) (authorizable, iownable, iauthorizable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
